transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: usedTokens prefers input + cache_creation + cache_read when all three are present, else total_input_tokens. If those are missing and a provider percentage is in 0..100, usedTokens is capacity times that percentage over 100.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: capacity must be > 0 or the event is dropped, except the empty-window case.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: current_usage null with total_input_tokens 0 and positive capacity emits usedTokens 0 and no percentage. Other null current_usage emits context-window:invalidated reason provider-reset, and the monitor replace clears context.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: A hook context-window:invalidated also clears the monitor context family.

transforms.name: adapter-step-4
transforms.effect: Child tokenCount, contextWindowSize, and tokenSamples are parsed and are not copied into monitor context or usage.
